profile: Xencor is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that discovers and develops engineered antibody therapeutics for cancer and autoimmune diseases. Its protein engineering technologies support XmAb drug candidates with features such as multi-target activity, bispecific structures, and extended half-life. The company advances candidates through clinical development and may develop programs with partners. Its research portfolio includes T-cell engaging antibodies and candidates for solid tumors and autoimmune conditions.
